def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = design.rootComponent
    body = root.bRepBodies.item(0)
    # List planar faces with normal +Z or -Z (pocket floors, top, bottom) with centroid
    print("=== Horizontal planar faces (pocket floors / tops) ===")
    for i, f in enumerate(body.faces):
        geo = f.geometry
        if type(geo).__name__ != 'Plane': continue
        n = geo.normal
        if abs(abs(n.z)-1.0) > 0.01: continue
        bb = f.boundingBox; mn=bb.minPoint; mx=bb.maxPoint
        c = f.centroid
        print(f"F{i}: z={mn.z*10:.2f} normal_z={n.z:.0f} area={f.area*100:.1f} centroid=({c.x*10:.1f},{c.y*10:.1f}) x[{mn.x*10:.1f},{mx.x*10:.1f}] y[{mn.y*10:.1f},{mx.y*10:.1f}]")
    print("=== Vertical cylinders (holes/bosses) ===")
    for i, f in enumerate(body.faces):
        geo = f.geometry
        if type(geo).__name__ != 'Cylinder': continue
        if abs(abs(geo.axis.z)-1.0) > 0.01: continue
        bb = f.boundingBox; mn=bb.minPoint; mx=bb.maxPoint
        c = geo.origin
        print(f"F{i}: r={geo.radius*10:.2f} z[{mn.z*10:.2f},{mx.z*10:.2f}] center=({c.x*10:.1f},{c.y*10:.1f}) area={f.area*100:.1f}")
